name: Ohio
licensingAuthorityNote: Ohio trade licenses for larger jurisdictions go through the Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board (OCILB); some smaller municipalities license independently.

faqs.question: Did Ohio recently change its out-of-state licensing rules?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ohio adopted a Universal License Recognition law in 2024, requiring recognition of out-of-state occupational licenses for applicants with at least one year of active, good-standing licensure, subject to Ohio's application process.
